integrity_statement: Exact infinite-family formulas proved from explicit three-hub repair-cost decomposition, matching extremal constructions, and a cyclic relabeling argument. Finite exhaustive verification is supplementary, not the infinite proof. A plausible older fixing-number source was accessible only through its abstract; independent audit not performed.
limitations: Applies to three-color ordinary and weak chromatic villainy of friendship graphs and weak villainy of three disjoint copies; no assertion on larger clique windmills, arbitrary block graphs, or unrestricted chromatic palette sizes. The general three-copy identity is prior work. Historical priority beyond inspected accessible sources is not guaranteed.
title: Chromatic repair radii of friendship graphs and an unbounded three-copy gap
